ui_dh.title: Definitions
ui_dh.subtitle: Set up the basics once here; every other area (sales, stock, production, transport) uses these definitions.

groups_hint.stock: What you buy and keep, and who you buy it from.
groups_hint.sell: What you make, what you sell and their labels.

help.warehouses: Create your warehouses first (even if you have only one). Stock is always kept in a specific warehouse, and one of them is the sales warehouse.
help.items: Anything you buy or keep: raw material, semi-finished, packaging or finished goods. Set the unit and minimum stock here.
help.suppliers: Who you buy from. Purchase invoices and the purchase list pick from this list.
help.formulas: If you make things, say which materials and how much go into each one. Production and stock deduction follow the formula.
help.products: Finished goods you sell or deliver. They are the same stock items, just shown here on their own.
help.barcodes: Make barcodes for items and products and print labels. This step is optional.
help.customers: Customers you invoice, give credit to or deliver to.
help.users: Everyone who signs in: staff (you write the title and tick the access yourself) and drivers or couriers (driver app only).

empty_hint.warehouses: Stock can't be recorded without a warehouse. Start with one.
empty_hint.items: Add the first item or material you buy or keep.
empty_hint.products: Add the first finished product you sell.
empty_hint.suppliers: Add your first supplier so you can pick it on purchase invoices.
empty_hint.users: Add staff, drivers and couriers so everyone signs in with their own username.

people.title: Users & access
people.subtitle: Everyone who signs in. Pick the kind of person first; only the fields that kind needs are shown.
people.type_hint: The kind of person decides what is needed. You can edit it later.

staff.title: Staff member
staff.hint: Write the job title yourself and tick exactly the sections and actions they need.

transport.title: Driver or courier (transport)
transport.hint: Order couriers and cargo / product drivers alike. They only see the driver app; set their vehicle right here.

people.job_title_hint: Write any title you like; it is only a label and grants nothing.
people.access_hint: Nothing is ticked in advance. Tick only what this person needs; you can only give what you have yourself.
people.transport_group_hint: These ticks are for office staff who manage deliveries. Add the drivers and couriers themselves as "Driver or courier".

transport.name: Full name

cargo.title: Cargo & products
cargo.hint: Moves goods between warehouses, suppliers and customers.

transport.signin_hint: They sign in to the driver app on their phone with this username and password. The business prefix is added automatically.
transport.signin_optional: Optional: with a username and password they can sign in to the driver app on their phone.
transport.signin_linked: The username is fixed. To change the password, type a new one.
transport.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current password
transport.no_record: No driver details for this account yet; press "Edit".
